digest.component_or_area: attestation validity and plan-review pin enforcement
propositions: Signed material pins become the single related-material validity check across all plan-review consumers via a new derive_plan_material_pin_health helper that classifies pins as current, stale-pin-drift, stale-pin-missing, or malformed-pin.

Optional enforce_plan_material_pins configuration (fail-open, key-local catch) invalidates attestations with pin drift or malformed records when enabled; disabled mode reports identical health advisorily without changing valid.

compute_validity extended with PlanValidityProfile (DEFAULT, CLOSE, DRIFT_REFRESH) allows policy-aware validity checks; CLOSE and DRIFT_REFRESH both disable code freshness while retaining signature, registry, own-material, and pin checks.

Review-time related_material records are persisted in sidecars as optional reviewed_related_material field (plan_review_result_v2 unchanged) and parsed with exact item validation; absent field alone is legacy-unpinned.
resign_plan_review reads reviewed_related_material from sidecar and enforces pin health without calling compute_validity, enabling failed-sign recovery without a certified attestation.

drift_refresh_candidate delegates all validity checks including pins to compute_validity(DRIFT_REFRESH) before probing code drift, making reopened or drifted attestations ineligible for progressive refresh.
